mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase (purchase_no, partner_id, company_info_id, purchase_date, total_amount, status, memo, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{purchaseNo}, #{partnerId}, #{companyInfoId}, #{purchaseDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{memo}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, purchase_no, partner_id, company_info_id, purchase_date, total_amount, status, memo, created_by, created_at, canceled_at FROM purchase WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, purchase_no, partner_id, company_info_id, purchase_date, total_amount, status, memo, created_by, created_at, canceled_at FROM purchase ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
